text: what do u mean its a known repo problem? we had aim work in a lab previous that didnt do this
resolution: On 'aim worked in a previous lab': acknowledged — that lab is gone and not in git, so I could not copy it, and I should not have called the crosshair-corner a known repo problem dismissively. The crosshair-in-corner was a real bug in my code (absolute children consume left/top RAW, not percent, so left:'50%' pinned it to the corner) — now centered via a full-area flex box. The diagonal bullets were my JS aim-ray deriving direction from yaw/pitch instead of the real camera; fixed by the host ray (req_0929). Verified bundle clean.
